title: Leveling Murder
titleNative: レベリング・マーダー
synopsis: One day, Yamato Onitsuka, an office worker, kills another man who attacked him. When he took that man's life, a sound effect rang in his head informing him of his own strengthening and the acquisition of a spell. He had become a "murdelizer", a being whose level goes up when he kills someone. Yamato Onitsuka resolves to survive even if it means killing people as and to keep on living he needs to kill someone within a week or he will die.

title: Eko Eko Azaraku
synopsis: When the chant "Eko Eko Azarak" sounds something is bound to occur, be it within the town or the school! A classic horror manga, Eko Eko Azarak follows the witch Misa Kuroi ("Black Mass" in Japanese), and the various horrors she encounters during her travels. While relatively unknown outside of Japan the series was extremely well received domestically. It lasted for 19 volumes, spawned two sequels, an OVA, two TV series, six live action films and two video games. Included one-shot: Volume 19: Hitokui Ichizoku

synonyms: The Lawyer Can't Choose the World He Protects
synopsis: Elite prosecutor Nakamura Yuki attempts to prosecute the president of an IT company for a heinous traffic accident, but ends up being killed by the powers of darkness. When he comes to, he finds himself faced with a goddess who asks him to "bring order to her world with the power of law." Yuki accepts the proposal and is given the skills to be a guardian of the law, then reincarnates into another world. His first job is to defend the legendary dragon, who has been charged with "murder" after burning to death a party of heroes with his flame breath! (Source: Morning Two, translated)

title: World Teacher: Isekaishiki Kyouiku Agent
titleNative: ワールド・ティーチャー 異世界式教育エージェント
synonyms: World Teacher: Other World Style Education & Agent
synopsis: Sirius is one of the best special agents that his generation has ever seen, but he gets KIA in an effort to save his colleagues. Fortunately for him, he gets reincarnated after his death, and now he’s a young boy in a completely different world! One of Sirius’ unfulfilled tasks in his previous life was to pass on his knowledge and experience to a student, someone who could continue his legacy. Still wanting to fulfill this dream of his, he sets out to meet those who he will deem as pupils in this new world he’s been reincarnated into! And thus the story of Sirius, the best special agent that has ever lived, and his quest to become someone else’s mentor and role model begins! “If you have nothing to lose, follow me! I will teach you how to live in this world!” (Source: Tentai Books)
